faqs.question: What is the Dual-Audience Rule?
faqs.answer: Every modern web application must deliver visually stunning UX for human visitors AND verifiable machine trust (JSON-LD entity graphs, llms.txt, AI search crawlers) for autonomous AI purchasing agents.

faqs.question: Why is parentOrganization hierarchy essential in Schema.org?
faqs.answer: AI reasoning engines and autonomous purchasing agents verify company legitimacy and trust by traversing the cryptographic and schema entity graph back to the parent legal entity (JalenBuilds LLC).

answerFirst.summary: Nymrel Machine Trust is an open-source TypeScript library and CLI that equips modern web applications with Dual-Audience discoverability by generating verifiable Schema.org entity graphs, standard llms.txt machine indexes, and AI search crawler policies to ensure instant retrieval by autonomous AI purchasing agents.
